金十期货7月16日讯，据上海证券报报道，
1. 停产十个月后，宁德时代枧下窝锂矿的复产传闻持续升温。7月7日，信用中国官网公示，宜春时代新能源矿业有限公司已获得非煤矿矿山企业安全生产企业变更许可，许可范围为3000万吨/年。一位接近宁德时代的人士表示，目前枧下窝锂矿核心的采矿、选矿、冶炼环节均已复产，一两周内可以满产。
2. 不过，上海证券报记者实地探访发现，选矿厂暂无运输卡车进出，矿区内有工作人员进行实地测量和插旗作业，山坡上有挖掘机正在作业。法律人士表示，这些作业在法律意义上或属于“筹备”而非“生产”。

Jinshi Futures July 16, according to Shanghai Securities News report,
1. After ten months of suspension, rumors of the resumption of production at CATL's Jianxiawo lithium mine continue to heat up. On July 7, the Credit China official website announced that Yichun Times New Energy Mining Co., Ltd. has obtained a permit change for non-coal mine safety production, with a permitted capacity of 30 million tons per year. A source close to CATL said that the core mining, beneficiation, and smelting processes at Jianxiawo mine have resumed, and full production could be achieved within one to two weeks.
2. However, a reporter from Shanghai Securities News visiting the site found that no transport trucks were entering or leaving the beneficiation plant, staff were conducting field measurements and flagging operations in the mining area, and excavators were operating on hillsides. Legal professionals said these activities may legally constitute 'preparation' rather than 'production.'
